scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @gal-toolbox/api" "npm run dev -w @gal-toolbox/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gal-toolbox/web && npm run build -w @gal-toolbox/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gal-toolbox/api && npm run typecheck -w @gal-toolbox/web
scripts.test: npm run test:tag-translations && npm run test -w @gal-toolbox/api && npm run test -w @gal-toolbox/web
